page_title: BET 1-1 GIR | Betis v Girona 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+1' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Iosu Galech had no choice but to send Antony (Betis) off. VAR seen to good effect there!

90' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Antony (Betis), but referee Iosu Galech must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90' The foul by Antony (Betis) was seen by Iosu Galech who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' The referee shows a yellow card to Cucho Hernandez (Betis). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
88' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
87' 7:4 – this is the current number of shots on target. The total number of attempts is 23:11.
83' Iosu Galech shows a yellow card to Nelson Deossa (Betis) for his blatant foul.
82' Michel has decided to substitute Vladyslav Vanat and he is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Abel Ruiz (Girona) coming on for Azzedine Ounahi.
81' The game is interrupted as Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is flagged offside.
80' It must be a yellow card. It is. Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
80' The linesman signals that Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
79' Hugo Rincon (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Iosu Galech had an easy-decision to make.

77' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. But his low attempt from just outside of the box went straight towards the middle of the goal and Paulo Gazzaniga made a comfortable save.
76' Substitution. Nelson Deossa (Betis) replaces Marc Roca.
75' 1 - 1 Isco takes the corner and Valentin Gomez (Betis) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the top left corner. The score is 1:1.
75' The referee signals a corner kick to Betis.

75' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
74' A player from Girona commits a rough challenge. Iosu Galech blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Betis will take a free kick near the side line.
73' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
71' Girona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

68' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) takes a good first touch from a cross and fires a powerful low shot from the edge of the box towards the left post. The goalkeeper, though, is ready and denies him with a brilliant save.
66' Michel prepares a substitution. Viktor Tsygankov is replaced by Joel Roca (Girona).
66' The substitution has been made. Yaser Asprilla (Girona) has replaced Bryan Gil.
64' A quickly taken corner by Betis.
64' Isco (Betis) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Betis win a corner kick.
62' Now Betis have a corner.
62' The ball is cleared after Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Betis are awarded a corner kick.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Isco (Betis) will replace Pablo Fornals.

59' Antony (Betis) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the bottom right corner from a promising distance, but Paulo Gazzaniga denies him.
58' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

58' This shall not pass! Pablo Fornals (Betis) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.
57' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Girona.
56' Antony (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
53' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
53' Rough tackle by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Girona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
52' Betis take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Neat passing move from Betis in order to create new attacking opportunities.
49' Iosu Galech blows his whistle as Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Girona get a free kick.
48' Hugo Rincon (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
47' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a half-time substitution. Sofyan Amrabat comes on in place of Giovani Lo Celso (Betis).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Manuel Pellegrini gives a chance to Aitor Ruibal and Hector Bellerin (Betis) is off.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Manuel Pellegrini probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis). He is replaced by Abde Ezzalzouli.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' That was close by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A cross from Hector Bellerin (Betis) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Betis.
42' Pablo Fornals (Betis) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.

42' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.

41' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
41' The ball has crossed the sideline. Betis are taking a throw-in.

39' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Paulo Gazzaniga makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
38' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes.
36' Antony (Betis) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
36' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
34' Girona are awarded a mid-range free kick.
33' Marc Bartra (Betis) has tested the patience of referee Iosu Galech and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
32' Great teamplay by Betis as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

32' Arnau Martinez (Girona) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

30' Valentin Gomez (Betis) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
30' The ball goes out of play and Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Pablo Fornals (Betis) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
29' Pablo Fornals (Betis) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
28' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
28' Girona are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
25' Marc Bartra (Betis) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
25' The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
24' Antony (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Betis will take a corner kick.
24' A short pass finds Cucho Hernandez (Betis) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.

23' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. A free kick has been awarded to Betis.
22' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

20' 0 - 1 Superb finishing from Vladyslav Vanat (Girona). Bryan Gil plays a fantastic through ball and finds Vladyslav Vanat (Girona), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a low shot from close range past the goalkeeper. It's 0:1.
20' The ball is laid off to Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Alvaro Valles to make a decent save.
19' Girona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
17' Some great controlled play and passing from Betis. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Betis showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
15' Girona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

13' Valentin Gomez (Betis) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
12' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vitor Reis (Girona) was quite harsh and Iosu Galech didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
11' Ivan Martin (Girona) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
10' Girona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
9' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
8' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Hector Bellerin (Betis). The ball is behind the touchline and Betis will take a throw-in.
8' Bryan Gil (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but Alvaro Valles comes off his line to gather the ball.
7' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

3' That was close by Antony (Betis)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
1' Axel Witsel (Girona) commits a rough challenge and Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Betis.
1' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
